snapshot.about: Persistent Systems provides software engineering and strategy services to help companies implement and modernize their businesses. It has its own software and frameworks with pre-built integration and acceleration  . It also has partnership with providers such as Salesforce and AWS  .
key_points: The company is a global digital services and solutions provider specializing in AI-led, platform-driven digital engineering and enterprise modernization. It offers end-to-end capabilities across software and product engineering, data and AI, cloud-enabled enterprise modernization, customer experience (CX) transformation, intelligent automation, and analytics. The company serves diverse industries, including software and high-tech, banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI), and healthcare and life sciences.
